faults.scenario: An inspector was unhappy with Tobi's tool store. Here is what she found.

lines.text: Cement had hardened on the trowels.
A spirit level had been knocked about in a heap.
lines.why: It must be protected from knocks.

lines.text: Shovels had been left in the walkway.
Steel tools were lightly oiled.
Tools were stored on racks.

written.explainPrompt: Why are steel tools cleaned and lightly oiled before storing?
written.explainGuide: Cleaning removes cement that would harden, and a light film of oil keeps out moisture and stops rust, so the tool lasts longer.

correct: Close your instruments in their box when you finish.

wrong.text: Plan to wire the house yourself to save money.
wrong.why: On site, only qualified electricians do electrical work.

wrong.text: Plan a socket directly over a kitchen sink tap for ease of use.
wrong.why: Water and sockets are a shock risk. Keep them apart.

wrong.text: Leave the distribution board out of the plan.
wrong.why: It must be shown. Every circuit starts there.

wrong.text: Use your own invented symbols for each point.
wrong.why: Others cannot read them. Use standard symbols.

wrong.text: Place the battery and inverter inside a closed cupboard over the cooker.
wrong.why: Heat and fire are a risk. Choose a safe, ventilated space.

decisions.prompt: How do you show which switch controls a light?

options.text: A note beside each room name

options.text: A heavy solid line to the board
options.consequence: That is not the link convention.

options.text: A dashed link from switch to light
options.consequence: That is the convention.

written.explainPrompt: State the function of the charge controller and the inverter in a solar system.
written.explainGuide: The charge controller prevents battery over-charge and deep discharge. The inverter converts the battery's d.c. into a.c. for the house.
